name: Browser Use
description: Python agent that takes a natural-language task and carries it out in a real browser by clicking, typing and navigating on its own.
whatItDoes: Lets developers hand a plain-language goal to an LLM-driven agent that then operates a website end to end: filling forms, searching, extracting data, completing multi-step flows. It targets developers who want to script web tasks without writing selectors, and it can use a local browser or the vendor's hosted browsers.
howItWorks: An Agent object is created with a task and an LLM. On each step the agent reads the page state, asks the model for the next action and executes it in a Chromium browser controlled through the DevTools protocol, repeating until the task is finished. A companion CLI and an installable skill let coding agents reuse the same browser control.

requirements.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
requirements.description: Key for the LLM used in the README example; other providers can be used instead

requirements.name: BROWSER_USE_API_KEY
requirements.description: Access to the vendor's own model and cloud browsers

models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and other chat models; vendor-hosted model optional
